rp.paragraph: If you register an account to use the Game then we will need some information from you to set this up. We will also process some information when you use the Game (e.g., to make sure your progress is saved) and when you buy items (e.g., to ensure you get the purchased content). If you choose to set up your Game profile using a social media account, we also collect information from that social media account. If you choose, you can provide certain other information to personalise the gaming experience and enable Game features, or participate in Game Services. If you choose to use the eSports Website, we will need your Game login credentials and other information, such as your email address, user and account information, and information to enable you to form or join teams and participate in eSport competitions for the Game. If you need to get in touch with us then we will also retain some information so that we can get back in touch with you and address any concerns. More Information.

We use your information to provide the many functions and services that comprise the Game Services. We also use your information for account verification, security purposes, to support and improve the Game Services, to process transactions as part of the Game Services, to provide you with game updates, and to enforce our terms, conditions and policies. We do not disclose your information to any third parties, except where we need to in order to provide the Game Services (e.g., use local cloud providers or to back up your data; using our affiliates around the world to help us to deliver the Game Services) or monitor the success of our marketing and advertising programs, or where we are instructed to by a court, authority or compelled by law. More Information.

Depending on where you live, you may have certain rights with respect to your information, such as rights of access, to receive a copy of your data, or to delete your data or restrict or object to our processing of your data. More Information.
If you have any questions about anything in this policy, or want to exercise any rights you may have, please contact us here.

If you do not agree to the processing of your personal information in the way this privacy policy describes, please do not provide your information when requested and stop using the Game Services. By using the Game Services, you are accepting our rules regarding your personal information as described in this privacy policy.

This section describes the different types of personal information we collect from you and how we collect it. If you would like to know more about specific types of data and how we use that data, please see the section entitled "How We Use Your Personal Information" below.

You give us information about you when you register for the Game (your nominated nickname, and information we import from your connected social media account (WeChat, Facebook, QQ, VKontakte, Twitter, Google Play, Game Center or LINE) in order to set up your profile, including your name as it appears on your social media profile, your user ID and your profile picture). For certain regions, you may also be asked to provide us with your date of birth (stored device-side only) to verify your age and for administration of the gameplay management system. If you are located in certain regions, we may ask you to provide an email address for the purpose of verifying parental or guardian consent to use the Game services if you are under the relevant minimum age. You also provide us with information when you set up your profile for the Game (including region location and information you voluntarily elect to provide in order to customise gameplay or Game Services, such as gender or photos you upload to your in-Game photo wall) or your nickname when you log-in as a 'guest' in order to use the Game.

Once a Game account is set up, you may also choose to provide us with your mobile phone number or email address and a password, which you may select yourself for these purposes. These will be bound to your account (once verified by way of a verification code we will send to you) for the purposes of enabling login by email or mobile phone number. If you choose to bind your phone number or email address with your account, you will have the option to login via your mobile phone number or email address and we will access your phone number or email address to verify you as a user without you having to enter a validation code or password every time you login. If you choose to bind your phone number, you can also enable two-factor authentication. Once enabled, we will verify additional data for authentication if you log in from a new device. If you choose to bind your email address, we will send an account security alert to your email address if we detect any suspicious activity. If you need to recover your account, we will ask you questions to verify your identity. If you would like to be featured on leaderboards, you will also be asked to bind your mobile phone number. For certain regions, we will ask you to bind your telephone number with your account when you change your location setting.

In addition, you may choose to provide your location (province and city) to use region-specific features, for example, our Battle Zone Leaderboard, People Nearby, Regional Chat Channel and birthday features. If you would like to use our birthday features, you may provide your birthday (month and day) and location. You may add your in-game weapon preferences, game mode preferences, voice chat preferences, audio self-introduction and any other information to your calling card and share your calling card and QR code with other players, if these functions are available in your region. You also provide us with information when you participate in a survey in the Game (in which case we will process the information you provide to us as part of the survey, which may include (amongst other information) your gender, age or age range, country or region of residence, income, education, occupation, contact information, nickname). When you participate in one of our sweepstakes events, which may be conducted in-Game, on our Website or otherwise, you provide us with information including email address, user ID, phone number, mailing address and country; when you register for a tournament, we will collect your name, email address, country/region, user ID, photo, and team name and team photo (if applicable); and when you register for an e-sports event or community event), we will collect (as applicable) your team name, registration region, team logo, your name, nationality or residency, email address, phone number, Discord ID (if applicable) and user ID. If you qualify to attend in person an e-sports or community event, we may also ask you for your ID or passport information, date of birth, gender, home address, phone number, photo and social media profile. If you participate in tournaments or e-sports events, we will use your user ID, nickname, battle videos and audio and video recordings during matches to validate that you are the correct Game user, to investigate any allegation of cheating and for marketing and promotion. In some instances, we may also take photos and videos of, and video record and livestream tournaments or Events that you participate in, in which case certain data relating to you or your team and videos of you will be processed, captured and displayed on public platforms. We may also retain photos and video recording of the tournament or Event for publicity and marketing purposes, and to improve our Game Services. If you are suspended from participating in tournaments or e-sports events for cheating or otherwise violating tournament or e-sports event rules, we use your name, Game nickname (including variations) and day and month of birth to enforce the suspension and may publish your nickname, the reason for the suspension and the duration on our Websites or social media channels. If you participate in one of our Events (including game-based events), to send you digital prizes if you win such prizes, we will process your email address and telephone number; to deliver physical prizes if you win such prizes, we will process your name (as shown on your passport), team name, email address, telephone number, mailing address and postal code; to deliver cash prizes if you win such prizes, we will process your name (as shown on your passport), email address, telephone number, and payment information (or payment may be made to your club or team bank account, as applicable); and if you share the Event with your friends, we will process your friends list.

If you would like to participate in Website events (if available in your region), we use your social media account information or email address to set up your account and your event registration information to register you for an event. If you win a prize at a Website event, we use your hashed nickname to announce your win and, in case of an in-Game prize, your user ID to deliver your prize; and a physical prize, your contact information to deliver your prize.
